title.zh: Session lock（会话密钥 lock）约束

subtitle.zh: 来源：luongthanhtung03/ckb-session-kit @ f51f07c / contracts/session-lock/src/main.rs　·　testnet 0xab41…08ce (data2)　·　社区项目，仅测试网
subtitle.en: Source: luongthanhtung03/ckb-session-kit @ f51f07c / contracts/session-lock/src/main.rs　·　testnet 0xab41…08ce (data2)　·　community project, testnet only

title.zh: Owner 模式：任意花费 / 撤销

label.zh: owner 的 cell（任意 lock，自行验签）

cons.zh: 任一输入 lock hash 等于它 → owner 模式，直接通过
cons.en: any input with this lock hash → owner mode, pass

role.zh: session key cell 的 lock hash

cons.zh: owner 不在场时必须有此 lock 的输入
cons.en: required among inputs when owner is absent

role.zh: 每笔最大流出 u64 LE（shannon，含手续费）
role.en: max outflow per tx u64 LE (shannons, fee included)

cons.zh: Σgroup 输入 − 找零 ≤ max_per_tx

role.zh: 最小间隔 u64 LE（区块）

cons.zh: >0 时每个 group 输入 since 必须为相对区块数 ≥ 该值
cons.en: if > 0 each group input's since must be relative block number ≥ it

role.en: 80B: none; 112B: recipient(32); 128B: token_type_hash(32)+max_per_tx_token u128(16); 160B: token + recipient

cond.zh: args 长度 ∈ {80,112,128,160}；script 读取缓冲 256B
输入中既无 owner_lock_hash 也无 session_lock_hash
cond.en: neither owner nor session lock hash among inputs

body.zh: Cell{ lock: 任意 }  // 无收款方限制
body.en: Cell{ lock: any }  // no recipient set

cond.zh: min_interval>0 且任一 group 输入 since 非相对区块数或 < min_interval
cond.en: min_interval>0 and a group input since is not relative-block or < min_interval

cond.zh: group 输入或找零带 type script
cond.en: group input or change has a type script

cond.zh: 回到本 lock 的输出 > 1
cond.en: more than 1 output back to this lock

cond.zh: Σgroup 输入容量 − 找零容量（饱和减）> max_per_tx（手续费也算流出）
cond.en: Σ group input capacity − change (saturating) > max_per_tx (fee counts)

body.zh: Cell{ lock: session_lock_hash }  // 容量 / token 不得增加
body.en: Cell{ lock: session_lock_hash }  // capacity / tokens must not grow

cond.zh: 其它输出 lock ∉ {本 lock, session key, recipient, owner}
cond.en: other output lock ∉ {this lock, session key, recipient, owner}

cond.zh: recipient / owner 输出带非 token 的 type
cond.en: recipient / owner output has a non-token type

cond.zh: session key lock 输出总容量 > session key lock 输入总容量（防止把额度转给 key）
cond.en: session-key outputs capacity > session-key inputs capacity (no siphon to the key)

title.zh: Token 会话（128B / 160B，xUDT/sUDT 类 u128 金额）

cond.zh: group 输入 / 找零带其它 type
cond.en: group input / change has another type

cond.zh: token 输入 data < 16B，或 token 找零 data ≠ 16B
cond.en: token input data < 16B, or token change data ≠ 16B

cond.zh: Σtoken 输入 − token 找零 > max_per_tx_token
cond.en: Σ token in − token change > max_per_tx_token

cond.zh: 限定收款方时 session key 的 token 输出 > 输入
cond.en: recipient set and session-key token out > in

cond.zh: CKB 容量仍受 max_per_tx 约束
cond.en: CKB capacity still bounded by max_per_tx

notes.zh: 本 lock 不验签：owner / session key 的签名由它们各自 lock 在同一交易中验证（输入中出现其 lock hash 即视为授权）。
notes.en: This lock verifies no signature: owner / session key signatures are checked by their own locks in the same tx (an input with that lock hash counts as authorization).

notes.zh: 过期时间（expiry）只在链下 SDK 中，链上不检查；撤销 = owner 模式花掉 cell。
notes.en: Expiry is off-chain (SDK) only, not enforced on chain; revoking = spending the cell in owner mode.
